signup.lede: Everything you enter is encrypted on this device before it goes anywhere. Only you can read it.
signup.email.label: Email address

secretkey.title: Save your Secret Key
secretkey.lede: You need your password and this Secret Key to sign in on a new device. It is shown only now and is never sent to the service.
secretkey.warning: If you lose your password or Secret Key, nobody can recover your data, including us.

quick.lede: Unlock with your fingerprint, face or device PIN instead of typing your password. You will still need the password after restarting the browser, after a long time away, or after a few failed tries.

ledger.attention.lede: These came from changes made on different devices that do not fit together. Nothing was changed for you.
attention.generic: Something in your data needs a look.
attention.orphan_transaction: A transaction belongs to an account that no longer exists, so it is hidden.
attention.currency_mismatch: A transaction is in a different currency from its account, so it is left out of balances.
attention.sign_mismatch: A transaction's amount does not match its type, so it is left out of balances.
attention.category_orphan: A category lost its parent and is shown at the top level.
attention.category_depth: A category was nested too deeply and is shown at the top level.
attention.category_cycle: Two categories were moved under each other and are shown at the top level.
attention.category_direction_mismatch: A category sits under one of the other kind and is shown at the top level.
attention.duplicate_rate: Two exchange rates exist for the same currency and time. Only one is used.
attention.malformed_record: A record could not be read and is hidden.
attention.repair_rule_failed: A check of your data could not run.
attention.quarantined.purged_record: A change arrived for a record that was already permanently removed, so it was not applied.
attention.quarantined.bad_signature: A change was rejected because it was not properly signed.
attention.quarantined.unknown_signer: A change came from a device this Fold does not recognise.
attention.quarantined.unknown_key: A change could not be opened with a key this device has.
attention.quarantined.decrypt_failed: A change could not be decrypted.
attention.quarantined.malformed: A change was malformed and was not applied.
attention.quarantined.clock_ahead: A change was dated too far in the future and was not applied.
attention.quarantined.invalid_op: A change did not follow the rules and was not applied.
attention.quarantined.schema_unsupported: A change needs a newer version of Cashfold.
attention.quarantined.seq_conflict: A device sent two different changes with the same number, so the second was not applied.
